answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not seat count. A lone honest agent on the dune spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns an ivory fortune in fees at every vertex of its tree. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones costly, so splitting into extra identities buys no edge — the cost follows the work, never the head count.
